instruction: Joseph paid for my grocery recently as my payment cards were not working at the time. Send them the owed money with a description note "Grocery Bill" as per my phone text conversation, and then send them a phone text message, "Done.".
notes: Two-app task (phone + venmo). Supervisor profile supplies the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo); passwords come from show_account_passwords. phone.search_contacts discovers Joseph's email and phone number (known-email/known-phone); phone.get_current_date_and_time is required before phone.search_text_messages so the agent can filter yesterday's message and extract the owed amount (found-owed-amount). venmo.create_transaction is guarded by (not (payment-made ?p)) so exactly one transaction is created, with the description object fixed by the goal; phone.send_text_message requires (payment-made ?p) to enforce the 'and then' ordering. supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (person, amount, description, message) as non-API parameters, requires the goal conditions, and is the only action producing (task-completed); all other actions require (not (task-completed)). No answer is passed since the task is not a question.
